title: Rotation View & Momentum Signals
changes: New: Rotation sub-view in Momentum tab — groups bucketed into 🌱 Emerging / → Established / 📉 Fading by regime signal
New: Acceleration badge (▲▲ building / ▼▼ fading) on Momentum cards — visible once 10 sessions of history exist (~Jun 23)
New: Trend slope glyph (↑↑/↑/~/↓/↓↓) on Today cards — 10-session sustained direction vs the noisy 1-week delta arrow
Improved: Strength tab Sustained list now sorted by Confirmed % (momentum × agreement) — rewards consistency, not just raw score
New: 'vs 20d ago' context row in Today expanded cards — shows Wk and YTD % change over the past month (arrives ~Jul 10)
Fix: Rotation card color threshold now consistent with bucket boundaries (was using 0.10 instead of 0.15)
UX: Momentum/Rotation sub-toggle now persists across page reloads

title: Dynamic Lookback Windows
changes: Movers tab window buttons (5d/10d/20d/50d) now derived from the CSV header at load time — no hardcoded values in JS

title: Momentum Variants & Trading-Day Lookbacks
changes: New columns: momentum_confirmed, momentum_weighted_mid/fast, momentum_accel, regime_short_long, rank_trend_slope
Lookback windows (5/10/20/50) now measured in trading sessions, not calendar days — weekends and holidays skipped automatically
Single source of truth for delta schema: scripts/delta_config.py
